status: PROPOSED_FOR_OWNER_RATIFICATION -- enforced as written until the owner amends it; the table is the authority boundary and is the owner's to change
RULE: A path may be written in a mode only if it matches one of the mode's may_write patterns and none of its may_not_write patterns; deny wins. Matching is the orchestrator's _match: exact, directory prefix, or fnmatch. BUILD may change architecture but may not self-certify: PROJECT_STATE.test_surface is marked current only from a suite run recorded in VERIFY mode at the current head. VERIFY may not alter the implementation it certifies. RESEARCH may not promote: no production path and no default-switch line. OPERATE freezes all code during a live slate and writes artifacts only.
reads_mode_from: coordination/PROJECT_STATE.json: mode_declared (owner statement, pins the mode; an agent may not change it) else mode.mode (measured, set only through coordination/mode.py which appends a HANDOFF_LOG row)

BUILD.meaning: may change architecture; may not self-certify
BUILD.self_certification: REFUSED: refresh_state and claude_finalize do not mark PROJECT_STATE.test_surface current from a BUILD-mode suite row

VERIFY.meaning: attempts to break what was built; cannot repair it
VERIFY.note: the runner, the registry and the manifest define what counts as proof and are implementation, not verification

OPERATE.meaning: live slate; production architecture frozen; artifact outputs only
OPERATE.note: nfl/production/runs/ and the two JSON reports are artifact outputs and are allowed despite the nfl/production/ denial: an explicit allow on a non-code artifact path wins over a directory denial only when the allow is the more specific pattern (see mode.py: specificity = pattern length)

RESEARCH.note: a default-switch line changed anywhere is a promotion, whatever file it sits in
